links.outcome: Prognostic value for all-cause mortality of AI vs clinician ejection fraction segmentation on same CMR data
links.effect: AI EF showed better model fit (AIC 57 936 vs 58 097, ΔAIC 161) and marginally better discrimination (C index 0·669 vs 0·637; ΔC 0·033 [95% CI 0·026–0·041]).
links.quote: AI ejection fraction showed better model fit (AIC 57 936 vs 58 097, ΔAIC 161 favouring AI) and marginally better discrimination (C index 0·669 vs 0·637; ΔC 0·033 [95% CI 0·026–0·041]).

screen.reason: Retrospective multicentre study comparing the prognostic value (mortality prediction) of deep-learning AI segmentation of cardiac MRI ejection fraction versus expert clinician segmentation.
